This is the remaining half of the V2.6.X preview I shared with you earlier.  https://discord.com/channels/1131791637933199470/1536776936678883328

Broadly speaking, these changes arrive in the form of new rewards and new choices — once they go live, we hope they'll inject fresh vitality into the game's economy.

This certainly isn't the whole of what we're working on! Once these ecosystem adjustments are wrapped up, we want to turn our attention back to some of the older combat components, Wheels of Destiny, and Awakeners and give them buffs. And then we'll be going all in on the pivotal version of our Astral Reign arc — V2.7.

As always, we're looking forward to your feedback in this thread, and we may make any adjustments necessary when these changes are implemented.
thread_title: Preview: V2.6.X Exchange Stores, Covenant Bonding & Affinity

content:
Hello everyone, this is Light, producer of Morimens.

Over the past few months, a great many Keepers have told us about places where our systems could use an update. Thank you to everyone who took part in our surveys and left feedback — you've been an enormous help in improving the game! Now, after finally carving out a bit of time from development hell, our team has taken a deep look at the game and drafted an initial direction for future updates.

I'd like to share the issues we've identified and our draft plans with you in the form of a devlog. Since there's a lot to cover, these adjustments will be rolled out across several minor updates within the V2.6 major version. As always, we're looking forward to your feedback in this thread, and we may make any necessary adjustments during implementation.
